def media_type(filename):

def meal(hhmm):

import csv, os

def save_student(path, name, home):
    is_new = not os.path.exists(path) or os.path.getsize(path) == 0
    with open(path, "a", newline="") as file:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=["name", "home"])
        if is_new:
            writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerow({"name": name, "home": home})
h: Decide is_new BEFORE opening in append mode.

drills.p: fix_name(name): "Malan, David" becomes "David Malan". Tolerate a missing or extra space after the comma and stray outer spaces. A name with no comma comes back unchanged (stripped).
drills.x:

assert fix_name(" Malan,   David ")=="David Malan" and fix_name("David Malan")=="David Malan"
drills.r:
import re

def fix_name(name):
    name = name.strip()
    matches = re.search(r"^(.+?)\s*,\s*(.+)$", name)
    if matches:
        return f"{matches.group(2)} {matches.group(1)}"
    return name
h: Group 1 is the first set of parentheses, not group 0.

import re

def github_username(url):
    matches = re.search(r"^(?:https?://)?(?:www\.)?github\.com/([a-z0-9-]+)/?$", url, re.IGNORECASE)
    return matches.group(1) if matches else None
h: A group written (?:...) does not capture; only the username gets plain parentheses.
Put the hyphen last in the character class so it is literal.
